heading.text: We don't just sell the machine.

blocks.heading: The VCS difference
blocks.body: At VCS we understand how complex and expensive it can be to purchase a machine which is why we offer free shipping and consultation on all equipment.

blocks.heading: 4 hour emergency response window
blocks.body: We provide a 4 hour emergency response window for contract customers across our full service area.

blocks.heading: 85+ parts on the shelf
blocks.body: La Marzocco service kits, gaskets, sensors, boilers, electronics, stocked in Long Island City. No factory wait.

about.body: Vera Coffee Solutions is built by operators, for operators. From our Bridgeport, CT facility we sell, install and service the world's best commercial espresso equipment — and at our Long Island City roastery we roast coffee for cafés, restaurants and corporate accounts who want a program built around their brand.
